name: Weak RCA: jumps to a conclusion on payment success rate

messages.text: Payment success rate across all merchants fell from 86.5% to 84.8% over the past five days. How would you investigate?
This is probably a bank outage. Banks have downtime all the time, so I would call our banking partners and ask them what happened.
Before calling anyone, how would you know whether it's a bank issue or something else?
I think it's mostly banks because that is the most common reason. Maybe also the internet was slow for users. I would look at the dashboard and see if it went down.
The dashboard is what showed the drop. What would you break the number down by?
We could look at it by bank I guess. And then tell the bank with the most failures to fix their system and maybe give users a discount so they try again.
What if failures are spread evenly across banks?
Then it might be users entering wrong card details, so we can add a tooltip on the card number field to help them type it properly. That should improve the success rate.
Okay. Anything else before we wrap up?
No, I think the main thing is to talk to the banks and add the tooltip, and the rate will go back up.
